primary_sources.supports: Existing-PID heap tracing and optional stacks; instrumentation and loss caveats.
Heap handle/address/source event fields; not the original HeapFree BOOL return.

design.route: StartTraceW with the Microsoft existing-PID heap extension encoding; no KernelTraceControl DLL or WPT command required.
design.pinned_source_adaptation: PID item and property extension encoding match the pinned primary source. Requested stack IDs are allocation and free; Microsoft source example requests allocation and reallocation. Unsupported stack/session flags are a precise blocked status, never an automatic fallback.
design.helper: Existing guest Framework/v4.0.30319/csc.exe compiles the new C# fixture /platform:x86. Actual PE32 machine and helper IsWow64Process receipts are checked. Missing compiler is blocked; no install.
phases: Helper readiness before StartTrace, identifying PID/TID and WOW64.
Start a uniquely named PID-targeted heap session; failures never stop or reconfigure an existing logger.
Own helper creates a heap, allocates 152 and 296 bytes, frees only the first, reports its real BOOL and addresses, and waits.
Stop the owned session before asking the helper to free the second allocation and destroy its heap. The second allocation is the live negative example during the entire recorded period.

Offline decoder reads the full original ETL and matches exactly those two allocation records and one free, with raw header PID/TID/timestamp, pinned version-zero payload width, heap/address/size/order and operation-envelope checks. A free for the live allocation rejects.
design.cleanup: StopTrace in finally only if this controller acquired the exact unique session handle. Stop errors, forced owned-helper termination, nonzero losses, runtime over budget or implementation drift block capability. Helper finally frees its own allocations on error. No game process is opened.
design.temporary_storage: Host work uses F:/project/chaomofa/.venv-audit/native-worker/tmp. Guest compiler TEMP/TMP are a new artifact-directory/tmp inside the guest disk on F. No toolkit installation or registry writes.
limitations: This is an executable capability test, not an actual guest success source. No VM or native helper has been launched by this agent.
The capture CLI returns 2 when a trace is retained for decoding; that is intentional incomplete acceptance. Decode success also returns 2 and accepted remains false.
Unknown event versions, ambiguous pointer flags, non-WOW64 layouts, foreign heap events, missing/duplicate events or losses reject. No guessed schema or success return is substituted.

The decoder uses the pinned Microsoft raw heap payload parser, not a new claim that TDH was observed. Original headers/payloads for matches and bounded first schema samples remain in the report; the full ETL is authoritative.
Stack capture is requested, but only actual extended-data counts are reported initially. Caller stack content and its association are not yet verified.
The event schema does not provide the HeapFree BOOL. A real BOOL comes only from this owned fixture, never from the original game.
Elapsed budgets are checked around work and at callbacks; blocking OS calls are not claimed to have hard real-time deadlines.

A successful future helper trace cannot prove protected original-game compatibility, CRT free hook approval, TLS clearing, PTD release, small-block allocator cleanup, original handle closure, or complete ABI/state.
design.actual_stop_binding: New directly observed GetSystemTimePreciseAsFileTime envelopes surround StartTrace and StopTrace. Pure checks require ready <= start <= helper operation <= stop <= helper cleanup; ETL end must precede stop completion and retained-allocation cleanup.
design.cleanup_failure_reporting: Each emergency helper kill/wait, pipe read/close and final identity operation preserves a bounded blocker. A still-live helper stderr is never synchronously read; the report states remaining ownership instead of hanging or claiming cleanup.

cases: exact extension encoding and PID zero/bool rejection
failed start cannot stop existing logger
helper owner and timing mismatch rejection
actual StopTrace envelope after helper operations and before cleanup
failed emergency kill preserves blocker without blocking stderr read

remaining_first_dependency: Main must independently review and deploy only this new helper/module and frozen ABI dependencies, then run one short guest capability capture. Missing compiler or StartTrace unsupported/denied status is the exact blocker. Do not begin original-game heap tracing or a long prefix based on local tests.

original_PTD_context.known: 219 startup observations show mode 1, flags 1, heap 0x043F0000, PTD 0x043F0D78 and header 0x043F0D58. Hook 0x578120 and callback 0x56CF50 remain pointer observations.
original_PTD_context.absent: No actual original free result/event/stack or TLS-zero transition exists. The proposed helper identifies only whether PID-targeted WOW64 heap event collection works.
